technique_name: Compare and contrast two characters from Dr. Seuss's "The Cat in the Hat".
description: The Cat in the Hat and the Pet are the two main characters in Dr. Seuss's "The Cat in the Hat". The Cat in the Hat is a mischievous character, often taking on a sneaky, trickster-like role. He is also a figure of fun and chaos, introducing trouble by breaking the normal boundaries and rules that the children are trying to abide by.
